FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 7
Committee: Confirmations Sponsor: Senator Gerald Allen
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 07/18/2023
Senate Bill 7 as introduced would make a supplemental appropriation for the fiscal year ending
September 30, 2023, from the State General Fund in the amount of $10 million to the
Department of Mental Health to be used for an adolescent mental health unit in Pickens County.
